feed.title: causari — Survival Report
feed.subtitle: Weekly counts of surviving lines from AI-tagged commits in open-source repositories. No ranks, no verdicts. CC-BY-4.0.

entry.title: Survival Report #2 · 2026-09-23
entry.summary: 14,015,893 of 28,046,116 lines introduced by 60,693 AI-tagged commits in 55 open-source repositories are still at HEAD (50.0 %). 95 % interval over the sampled repositories: 33.4 % to 74.3 %. Counts, not grades. CC-BY-4.0. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22928161.

entry.title: Survival Report #1 · 2026-09-20
entry.summary: 462,838 of 754,476 lines introduced by 12,349 AI-tagged commits in 10 open-source repositories are still at HEAD (61.3 %). 95 % interval over the sampled repositories: 53.0 % to 64.9 %. Counts, not grades. CC-BY-4.0. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22863966.
